id: \rMy friend didn't bring enough money so he is waiting outside. He wanted me to get him this, but he doesn't deserve it now.
en: \rMy friend didn't bring enough money so he is waiting outside. He wanted me to get him this, but he doesn't deserve it now.
it: \rIl mio amico non ha portato abbastanza soldi, quindi aspetta fuori. Voleva che gli prendessi questo, ma adesso non se lo merita.
